info.title: TarotGen.io API
info.description:
The backend for **TarotGen.io** — a PHP 8.5 / Slim 4 hybrid-REST API.

- Resources are plural nouns (`/decks`, `/readings`); items are `/{id}`.
- `GET` reads, `POST` creates (→`201`) or runs a command, `PUT` replaces,
  `PATCH` applies a partial update / flag toggle, `DELETE` removes (→`204`).
- State transitions that aren't a plain field-set are `POST …/{id}/{verb}`
  (e.g. `…/finalize`, `…/approve`, `…/draw`).
- Errors are `{ "error": "…" }`; multi-message validation is `{ "errors": […] }`.
- Auth is a session cookie (`PHPSESSID`) set by the `/auth/*` endpoints —
  there are no API keys or bearer tokens for first-party calls.

get.summary: The current user's readings, newest first (one page with ?limit, else all)
get.description:
The current user's readings, newest first. The site pages with ?limit and
reads the total from X-Total-Count; without ?limit every reading comes back
as a plain array, which the Dalamud plugin's List<Reading> still expects —
keep that shape until the plugin pages too (AUDIT §2.6).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (1–100). Omit to get every reading.

X-Total-Count.description: The user's total reading count (sent when paging with ?limit)

delete.summary: Delete one of the user's readings
delete.description: Delete one of the current user's readings.

patch.summary: Update a reading's name, notes, hidden-author flag, or view password
patch.description: Update a reading the current user owns: name, hidden author, view password.

delete.summary: Delete the account after re-entering the password (cascades readings)

patch.summary: Update the account profile (currently the display name)
patch.description:
Partial update of the current account's profile. Currently the only
editable field is the display name (previously the dedicated
PUT /account/display-name).

post.summary: Change the account password

post.description:
Submit one of the user's personal spreads as a public spread (copies into

get.description: List the current user's favorited spreads.

post.summary: Add a favorite spread

Remove a spread from the current user's favorites. The favorite is

Partial update of a contact message. Currently the only editable field is

One-shot dashboard payload: entity counts (cheap COUNT(*) queries) plus the
usage stats overview — so the dashboard loads with a single request.

delete.description:
Bulk delete: purge guest readings older than the given age. The window is
an allow-listed number of days passed as the `older_than_days` query param.

Report a problem with a card's image (rate-limited)

reason.description: Sent by the site and current plugin builds. Older plugin builds omit it; their reports only bump the counter.

details.description: What is wrong, in the reporter's words. Required when reason is `other`.

200.description: Already reported this card recently (counter not bumped)

400.description: Missing/invalid deck or card id, unknown reason, or `other` without details

429.description: Too many reports from this IP

200.description: Non-secret config the SPA needs before rendering

post.summary: Submit a contact-form message (rate-limited: 5/IP/hour)
post.description:
Public endpoint: submit a contact form message.
Rate-limited per IP to prevent spam.

post.summary: Submit a new deck for review (requires a signed-in user)
post.description:
Submit a new deck (requires a logged-in user). The deck is created
as unapproved (pending admin review).

get.summary: List every card available in a deck (for the custom-reading picker)
get.description:
List every card available in a deck as {card_id, name}, so the custom
reading screen can offer a picker. Mirrors the reading engine's card
resolution.
Public: list all approved deck systems.

post.summary: Submit a new deck system (requires a signed-in user; admins are auto-approved)
post.description: Submit a new deck system (requires auth). If admin, auto-approved.

get.summary: A single deck system with its cards
get.description: Public: get a single deck system with its cards.

200.description: The deck system plus its cards array

get.description:
Initiate the OAuth flow. Accepts an optional ?intent query param
('login', 'register', or 'link') so the callback knows what to do.

401.description: The link intent requires a session

get.summary: OAuth callback — redirects back into the SPA on success/failure
get.description: Handle the OAuth callback from Google.

post.summary: Unlink Google from the current account
post.description: Unlink Google from the currently logged-in account.

post.summary: Credential-creation options (requires session)
post.description: Generate WebAuthn credential creation options for the logged-in user.

post.summary: Complete passkey registration
post.description: Complete passkey registration: verify attestation and store credential.

post.summary: Assertion options; optional email scopes to a user's credentials
post.description:
Generate assertion options for passkey login.
Accepts optional email to scope to a specific user's credentials,
or no email for a discoverable-credential (resident key) flow.

post.summary: Verify an assertion and sign in
post.description: Verify a passkey assertion and log the user in.

delete.summary: Delete a passkey (blocked if it is the last one while password login is disabled)

get.summary: The signed-in user's linked plugin tokens (Connected Apps)

200.description: Array of linked tokens (never includes the token value)

delete.summary: Revoke a linked plugin token (forces the plugin to re-link)

get.summary: Fetch a reading (password-protected readings return a locked stub to non-owners)

200.description: The reading, or — when it has a password this requester has not given — the locked stub

post.summary: Unlock a password-protected reading for this session
Generate a random reading from a draw spec

requestBody.description: Draw spec: deck, spread or card count, and options

post.summary: Create a custom reading from explicitly chosen cards/positions

201.description: The created reading, as stored (not the viewer payload the other reading commands return)

put.summary: Save spread/placement positions onto an existing reading
put.description:
Update a reading's spread/placement information after a "Free Draw With Placement"
has been generated. The caller provides position data which is merged into the
existing reading_info JSON as a spread snapshot.

400.description: Position count mismatch or invalid data

post.summary: Draw additional cards into a non-final, non-custom reading you own
post.description:
Draw additional cards into an existing generated reading owned by the
caller. The new cards are appended to the draw; for a spread reading the
client then opens the placement editor to position them.

post.summary: Permanently lock a reading against further draws (owner-only, one-way)
post.description:
Mark a reading as final, permanently locking it against further draws.
One-way: there is no endpoint to undo it. Owner-only.

post.summary: Submit a spread into the moderation queue (rate-limited: 5/IP/hour)
post.description:
Public endpoint: accept a user-submitted spread into the pending queue.
Rate-limited per IP to prevent spam. Never exposes the stored row.

post.summary: Create an account (inactive until email activation). Rate-limited: 5/IP/hour.
Activate an account from the emailed token
Begin a password reset (always answers 200 — no account enumeration). Rate-limited: 5/IP/hour.

200.description: Identical response whether or not the account exists

post.summary: Complete a password reset

422.description: New password too weak (token not consumed)

post.summary: Password sign-in. Rate-limited: 10 failed attempts/IP/15 min.

200.description: Signed in; sets the session cookie

post.summary: Clear the session

SpreadPosition.description: One card slot in a spread layout.

order.description: 1-based: the nth card drawn goes here.

x.description: Card centre, % of the canvas width.

y.description: Card centre, % of the canvas height.

DrawCard.description: One drawn card, in draw order.

card_id.description: The card's number in its deck; a deck's extra cards come after its system's cards.

card_name.description: Absent when the deck has no name for the card (an extra card nobody has named yet).

SpreadSnapshot.description: The layout as it was when the reading was made, so a shared reading still renders after its spread is edited or deleted.

spread_id.description: The public spread it came from; 0 for a personal spread, a custom reading or a free-draw placement.

ReadingInfo.description: What was drawn, from which deck, in which layout.

deck_id.description: The deck the cards were drawn from.

origin.description: How it was made; a custom reading can't draw more cards. Absent on readings made before this was recorded.

spread.description: Absent for a free draw that was never placed.

ReadingView.description: A reading as the requester may see it: what GET /readings/{reading_id} and the reading commands (generate, unlock, draw, finalize) return.

reading_id.description: The code in the reading link.

reading_time.description: When it was made, UTC ("Y-m-d H:i:s").

reading_name.description: The owner's title for it, if any.

reader.description: "Guest", or the owner's display name unless they chose to hide it.

is_final.description: Locked for good against further draws.

can_draw_more.description: The requester may draw more cards into it: their own, not final, not custom.

LockedReading.description: Sent instead of the reading to anyone but its owner until they unlock it with its password (POST /readings/{reading_id}/unlock).

reading_name.description: The owner's title for it, if any — the only thing shown before unlocking.

CardReport.description: A card users have reported as having a problem with its image.

deck_name.description: Resolved deck name (from the decks table).

report_count.description: How many times this card has been reported.

resolved_at.description: When an admin marked it handled; null = open.

round.description: Goes up each time the card is reported again after being resolved.

submissions.description: Each reason given, newest first. Older reports may have none.

CardReportReason.description: What is wrong with a reported card.

CardReportSubmission.description: One user's report of a card, with their reason.

round.description: The card's round when this was submitted (see CardReport.round).

details.description: What the reporter wrote; may be empty.

system_short_name.description: Populated by JOIN queries — the deck system's short name.

system_total_cards.description: Populated by JOIN queries — the deck system's total cards.

DeckSystem.description: A tarot deck system (a family of decks sharing a card structure).

DeckSystemCard.description: A card definition within a deck system.

FavoriteSpread.description: A favourited spread: which table it lives in, and its id there.

spread_type.description: `public` for an official spread, `personal` for a custom one.

spread_id.description: The spread_id or user_spread_id, according to spread_type.

Passkey.description: A passkey registered to the signed-in user's account.

positions.description:
Array of position objects, each shaped:
['order' => int, 'title' => string, 'x' => float, 'y' => float, 'rotation' => int]

submitter.description: Resolved submitter label: the linked account's display name, or "Guest".

PluginToken.description: A linked-plugin personal access token (no secret value exposed).

Reading.description: A saved reading as stored — what the account pages and custom-reading creation return. Viewing a reading returns ReadingView instead.

is_final.description: One-way lock: when true the owner can no longer draw additional cards.

password_protected.description: Derived flag — true when a view password is set. The hash itself is never exposed.

ReadingSummary.description: A reading as the admin readings list shows it.

user_id.description: The owner, or null for a guest reading.

deck_name.description: The deck's name, or `Deck #<id>` once the deck is gone.

spread_name.description: The spread name, or empty for a free draw.

positions.description:
Array of position objects, each shaped:
['order' => int, 'title' => string, 'x' => float, 'y' => float, 'rotation' => int]

User.description: A user account in its safe shape (no secrets or hashes).

sessionCookie.description: Session cookie issued on sign-in. Sent automatically by the browser.
sessionCookie.name: PHPSESSID

pluginToken.description: Personal access token issued to a linked Dalamud plugin (Authorization: Bearer …).
